SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET , KEY_1 , KEY_2 , KEY_3 , KEY_4 , KEY_5 FROM kep.ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND TARGET in (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRSYSE0001' AND TYPE = 'PLNT') AND KEY_9 = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT podt.PLANT , prdt.LEGACY_PO_NO , prdt.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , prdt.BUYER_ITEM_NO , case when podt.status = 'D' then '31' else case when podt.do_qty = 0 then '1' when podt.gr_qty !=0 then 'K4' when podt.do_qty != 0 and podt.iv_qty =0 and podt.di_qty =0 and podt.gr_qty=0 then 'K1' when podt.do_qty != 0 and podt.iv_qty !=0 and podt.di_qty =0 and podt.gr_qty=0 then 'K2' when podt.do_qty != 0 and podt.iv_qty !=0 and podt.di_qty !=0 and podt.gr_qty=0 then 'K3' else 'XX' end
end SUC_FLAG , case when podt.status = 'D' then '31:발주삭제' else case when podt.do_qty = 0 then '1:성공(발주)' when podt.gr_qty !=0 then 'K4:입고완료' when podt.do_qty != 0 and podt.iv_qty =0 and podt.di_qty =0 and podt.gr_qty=0 then 'K1:수주접수' when podt.do_qty != 0 and podt.iv_qty !=0 and podt.di_qty =0 and podt.gr_qty=0 then 'K2:납품서생성' when podt.do_qty != 0 and podt.iv_qty !=0 and podt.di_qty !=0 and podt.gr_qty=0 then 'K3:배송완료' else 'XX' end
end ERR_DESC , podt.PO_NO , podt.PO_SEQ , prdt.iv_column as SEQ , podt.ITEM_QTY , podt.UNIT_PRICE , nvl(podt.DS_DATE,' ') as DS_DATE FROM kep.ICOMPODT podt, ICOMPRDT prdt WHERE podt.BUYER = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND podt.PO_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND podt.PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND podt.BUYER = prdt.BUYER AND podt.PR_NO = prdt.PR_NO AND podt.PR_SEQ= prdt.PR_SEQ
UPDATE kep.ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y' , KEY_10 = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND KEY_9 = 'N'
